Key.English: Furthest a vehicle may be ordered to reverse in one order, in meters. Orders pointing further back are shortened to this distance rather than refused.
Cursor is not behind the vehicle

Selected AI-driven land vehicles back up in a straight line until the cursor position is abeam of them. The cursor must be behind a vehicle for it to move; selecting a crew member orders the vehicle he is riding in.
Time in seconds a vehicle may spend reversing before the order expires.
